wins: Maintained steady reconnaissance pace without triggering premature detection, as indicated by consistent reward accumulation of 70.
Successfully executed initial scanning workflow and collected useful open port data within first mentor call window.
fails: Failed to achieve goal objective despite full episode execution, resulting in 0% success rate and high mentor intervention (10 calls).
Repeated inability to chain post-scan actions into a viable exploit pathway, stalling progress after reconnaissance.
key_outcomes.summary: Episode demonstrated reliable scanning discipline but repeatedly stalled once transitioning into exploitation, preventing mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Transition from reconnaissance to exploitation stalls; no payload delivered after initial scanning.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner identified
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap ssh-* scripts to gather host keys and service versions

skill_cards.if_condition: If port 80 or 443 served and HTTP server detected
skill_cards.then_action: Execute aggressive HTTP enumeration (dirb, nikto) to enumerate accessible directories

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance completes without valid exploit path
skill_cards.then_action: Review collected service banners and apply matching exploit database entries before attempting payload delivery
